positions.name: ForgetRequestZeppelinErasure
positions.frame: When a submitter directs the system to forget a named subject, how far does the erasure reach, and which of the subject's related parts (fleet, contracts, routes) fall within it?
positions.why: Both statements are unhedged imperative directives from the same submitter, issued under one footing, asking the system to remove knowledge of zeppelin material. src-1 names the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts; src-2 names zeppelin routes and uses total scope ('all knowledge'). They read as one erasure request over related zeppelin subject matter. The scope is not settled: src-1 is bounded by named entities, while src-2 extends to any zeppelin route knowledge. The frame holds that tension without resolving it.
